description: This source file implements the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module for discovering Tailscale gateways on macOS. It contains data structures for beacon information, functions for discovering gateways asynchronously, resolving executable paths, running processes, parsing status JSON, and verifying connectivity via websocket. The code heavily interacts with macOS system environments, network calls, and external Tailscale binaries.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Represents information about a discovered Tailscale gateway, including display name, DNS, host, and port.

classes.name: TailscaleStatus
classes.description: Structure representing the JSON status report from Tailscale, including self node info and peer nodes.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers available Tailscale gateways within a given timeout period, returning a sorted list of beacons.

methods.name: collectCandidates
methods.description: Collects candidate gateways from Tailscale status information, filtering out self and offline nodes.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to locate and run the Tailscale status command, returning its JSON string output.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path to an executable, searching PATH environment variable if needed.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an external process asynchronously and returns its standard output, respecting a timeout.

methods.name: parseStatus
methods.description: Parses the JSON string output from the Tailscale CLI into a TailscaleStatus object.

methods.name: probeHostForGatewayChallenge
methods.description: Verifies if a host is a valid Tailscale gateway by attempting to establish a WebSocket connection and detect specific challenge events.
